# An unusable gtk4 platform must not affect compiles for other platforms, and
# must fail with one actionable message when it is the target. `--opt
# gir=<missing>` reproduces a machine with no GTK 4 introspection data
# regardless of what is installed here.

# Compiling for html is completely unaffected: no gtk4 diagnostics.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --opt gir=/nonexistent/Gtk-4.0.gir --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html
! stderr 'gtk4'

# Targeting gtk4 itself names the missing file and how to supply it.
! sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt gir=/nonexistent/Gtk-4.0.gir --out=g app.sngl
stderr 'platform gtk4 is unavailable'
stderr '--opt gir='

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

window {
    main
}
